'''Biron''', callsign name "'''Snow Raptor'''" was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
In [[3642 BBY]] he was stationed [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] as part of an Imperial campaign to trap Republic in a quagmire and deprive them of resources. However, Biron and his men found a greater threat in the besieged by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] of the [[Hailstorm Brotherhood]]. Lacking man force to assault them directly, Biron was forced to seek temporary alliance with the enemy, meeting with [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] [[Kieral]] of [[Outpost Senth]]. Putting their issues aside, the officers focused on surviving at all costs, which meant taking out the Brotherhood. They began by setting up an ambush and asking a Republic citizen to serve as bait, firing a signal flare and attacking the Brotherhood so that Imperials could round them in. Once the scout known as [[Hatchling (scout)|Hatchling]] confirmed that the pirates were retreating to their fortress, the men planned a strike at the heart of the Brotherhood - an assault on the [[Chilling Death Spire]]. The main target was Brotherhood's spiritual leader [[Sav]], known to survive several extreme situations in Hoth's cold weather. The assault force consisted of three teams: [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Katcho]]'s men from Republic side, Sergeant [[Ennlicher]]'s squad from Imperial side and a gifted Republic citizen leading the assault. After Sav was cornered and killed, Kieral congratulated Biron on the joint operation and gave him and his men 24 hours to safely return to their own outpost.
